pr221.body:
## Why

The target remains an independent, approximately **5% reduction in complete resident-service time over the strongest qualified baseline**, with a defensible mechanism and support domain. The paper's overall target-only speculative gain does not establish the new mechanism's independent value. This research PR makes the remaining opportunity and correctness conditions reviewable.

**This is a research draft. No general 5% improvement, production qualification or new-method novelty is claimed.**

## Latest continuation

1. **Recover the omitted strong control.** The proposed Fig. 5 now displays all five original contrasts per A5000 deployment, including `L_P_D4 / W_L4_D4`, and all 220 root points. Its same-panel service reductions are **2.0116%, 1.0807%, and 1.5641%**. Published adjusted intervals are retained; the Qwen8 order confounding and joint cut/projection effect remain explicit. No new timing or same-panel phase decomposition is claimed.
2. **Audit actual source guards.** A 10-obligation table binds 20 source identities and 35 precise source regions. The packed path does not inherit marked loop4's dispatch rejection conditions; placement observation is capture-only; some failure paths rely on CLI termination rather than a reusable transaction poison contract. These are source-backed scope gaps, not evidence that the frozen measured deployment miscomputed. Twenty-two focused native qualification cases are explicitly `NOT_RUN`.
3. **Run the preregistered q4 frontier diagnostic.** Source commit `ef2766327e7821fe188d1ad788b2c3b05531eb9a` was published and all eight files read back before the single CPU run. Two controlled histories pass q4+q4 repeat, q8 versus q4+q4, and the predeclared frontier4/frontier5 consumer contracts. This is **56 full-vector pairs, 24 active-state pairs and 24 native-geometry pairs**, on an untrained two-layer F32 CPU fixture with F16 KV.
4. **Retain the output counterexample.** The frontier5 extra fifth vector differs in **117/128 and 128/128 entries**. It was diagnostic-only before execution. Equal argmax and matching KV do not establish full-output interchangeability. The common forced token 37 never consumes that vector. The real worker needs `L_4` to judge the fifth proposal and choose a correction; its complete requested-output obligation is unchanged.
5. **Specify a concrete architecture candidate.** Current packed groups occupy different CTA channels and do not explicitly reuse weight fragments across groups inside one block. The first proposed kernel would keep two independent four-column accumulator groups in one CTA. It must preserve the original reduction organization and pass exact replay before resource and latency comparison. The kernel is unimplemented and unmeasured.

Native tiling inside a known eight-row macro is distinct from choosing k3/k7 across cycles. The current worker has fixed k. The next real-request proposal closes the bonus → actual seed → fifth-proposal rejection → correction → next-phase chain in a separately versioned finite protocol; it does not replace S3 or any frozen experiment panel.

## Actual validation and work

| Check | Result and scope |
| --- | --- |
| Pre-execution source review | Six host-only admission/receipt tests pass; exact eight-file source/build binding frozen |
| One native CPU run | 1 model load, 14 contexts, 146 API = 146 physical calls, 3,612 target rows, 4 trims; no retry or timeout |
| Independent raw review | All 30 blobs / 7,385,976 bytes and all 42 stages checked without importing the producer verifier or running a model |
| Main comparison obligations | Eight comparison records × eight fields pass; unequal extra fifth outputs are reported separately |
| Figure | 15 ratios of totals and 220 roots independently checked; full proposed PNG visually reviewed |
| Static source audit | 20 files / 35 regions and archive twins checked; source evidence is not native qualification |
| Repository preservation | All earlier 88 files preserved; eight preregistered sources also unchanged; unrelated root and benchmark entries preserved |

This continuation adds **33 files / 742,576 bytes** in two commits, bringing this draft to **121 additive files**. Raw logs, binaries, model weights, native receipts and captures are not committed. No GPU was used and no native performance timing was admitted. Local checks and independent review are not a GitHub CI pass.

## Reading order

1. [Continuation entry and decision order](https://github.com/leecdiang/HeteroSpec/blob/af436df989570ad882db65bd8a4b265b9e8cfdae/benchmarks/frontier_cost_v1/next_study/README.md).
2. [Native findings and fifth-output boundary](https://github.com/leecdiang/HeteroSpec/blob/af436df989570ad882db65bd8a4b265b9e8cfdae/benchmarks/frontier_cost_v1/next_study/q4_frontier/RESULTS.md).
3. [Source guard audit](https://github.com/leecdiang/HeteroSpec/blob/af436df989570ad882db65bd8a4b265b9e8cfdae/benchmarks/frontier_cost_v1/next_study/guard_audit/SOURCE_AUDIT.md) and [actual consumer / pending-token implications](https://github.com/leecdiang/HeteroSpec/blob/af436df989570ad882db65bd8a4b265b9e8cfdae/benchmarks/frontier_cost_v1/next_study/guard_audit/ALGORITHM_IMPLICATIONS.md).
4. [Strong-control figure and interpretation](https://github.com/leecdiang/HeteroSpec/blob/af436df989570ad882db65bd8a4b265b9e8cfdae/benchmarks/frontier_cost_v1/next_study/paper_audit/README.md).
5. [Two-group weight-reuse hypothesis and three-arm experiment](https://github.com/leecdiang/HeteroSpec/blob/af436df989570ad882db65bd8a4b265b9e8cfdae/benchmarks/frontier_cost_v1/next_study/guard_audit/ARCHITECTURE_HYPOTHESIS.md).
6. [Independent cross-review](https://github.com/leecdiang/HeteroSpec/blob/af436df989570ad882db65bd8a4b265b9e8cfdae/benchmarks/frontier_cost_v1/next_study/review/CROSS_REVIEW.md).
7. [Preserved previous research findings](https://github.com/leecdiang/HeteroSpec/blob/1d902a116e93004a9d9627763d1a3eafff5e77ac/benchmarks/frontier_cost_v1/RESEARCH_FINDINGS.md) and [controller admission / design](https://github.com/leecdiang/HeteroSpec/blob/1d902a116e93004a9d9627763d1a3eafff5e77ac/benchmarks/frontier_cost_v1/controller/README.md).

## Remaining decision gates

- Recover and qualify the existing #218 S3 strong-backend service result. Its public head remains `4fe337a8ff349d547023f9dd60b8e114e5323207`; no completed S3 result was recovered in this continuation. The old title is not evidence of current server activity.
- Qualify packed descriptors and dispatch, then test the shared-weight hypothesis with real operands against backend-loop4 and current packed. Report numerical failures, resource costs and negative latency outcomes.
- Close real request semantics against an independent reference before any dynamic-depth or consumer-mask claim. The new diagnostic reference is not historical paper R.
- Collect matched deployment stage costs including reconciliation and controller overhead. The current runtime policy still abstains without admitted prices; capture-heavy CPU wall time cannot populate that catalog.
- Freeze a policy before held-out requests; compare strong fixed/runtime controls, stratify prefix lengths and report adverse strata. Same-panel phase decomposition, full platform configuration and the remaining supplement visual review are still open.

## Earlier evidence remains intact

The prior 32 M2 synthetic CPU request pairs, their complete-vector/state checks, the q2-versus-q1 failure, the separate q1 smoke, and the exposed-root causal predictor diagnostics retain their original scope and executed-source identities. The current positive q4 result does not rewrite those outcomes. The earlier observed predictor did not beat its simple past-only frequency comparison, and no admitted real controller cost table has appeared.

**Keep Draft.** This continuation updates research evidence and experiment design. Main, paper PR #222 and the existing S3 experiment are unchanged.
